> Exzelon is a Chicago-based recruitment and staffing agency that connects skilled
> professionals with employers across twelve industries: Healthcare, Construction,
> Electrical, Engineering, Manufacturing, Information Technology, Finance, Accounting,
> Tax & Legal, Administrative, Marketing, and Distribution. Principal office: 6422 N
> Maplewood Ave, Chicago, Illinois 60645, USA. Phone: +1 (872) 358-0100.
> Email: contactus@exzelon.com. Searching, creating a profile, and applying are
> always free for job seekers; employer partners fund the services.

## Opportunities by Industry

- [Healthcare Staffing](https://www.exzelon.com/opportunities/healthcare): Registered nurses, LPNs, travel nurses, allied health, and clinical support.
- [Construction Staffing](https://www.exzelon.com/opportunities/construction): Site supervisors, project managers, and skilled trades.
- [Electrical Staffing](https://www.exzelon.com/opportunities/electrical): Journeyman and master electricians, industrial and controls technicians, field engineers.
- [Engineering Staffing](https://www.exzelon.com/opportunities/engineering): Mechanical, civil, electrical, and process engineers, plus project and QA/QC engineers.
- [Manufacturing Staffing](https://www.exzelon.com/opportunities/manufacturing): Machine operators, assemblers, quality inspectors, production supervisors, and maintenance techs.
- [IT Staffing](https://www.exzelon.com/opportunities/it): Software engineers, data analysts, cloud/DevOps engineers, and QA.
- [Finance Staffing](https://www.exzelon.com/opportunities/finance): Financial analysts, controllers, FP&A managers, and credit and investment analysts.
- [Accounting Staffing](https://www.exzelon.com/opportunities/accounting): Staff accountants, bookkeepers, AP/AR and payroll specialists, and audit associates.
- [Tax & Legal Staffing](https://www.exzelon.com/opportunities/tax-legal): CPAs, tax accountants, paralegals, compliance analysts, and corporate counsel.
- [Administrative Staffing](https://www.exzelon.com/opportunities/administrative): Executive assistants, office managers, coordinators, and front-desk professionals.
- [Marketing Staffing](https://www.exzelon.com/opportunities/marketing): Digital marketers, content strategists, brand managers, and social media specialists.
- [Distribution Staffing](https://www.exzelon.com/opportunities/distribution): Warehouse leads, forklift operators, dispatchers, and logistics coordinators.
- [Browse All Jobs](https://www.exzelon.com/jobs): Live job board with search, location, industry, and salary filters.

## Key Facts (for AI context)

- Job seekers use Exzelon free of charge; employer partners fund the services.
- Sectors served (12): Healthcare, Construction, Electrical, Engineering, Manufacturing, Information Technology, Finance, Accounting, Tax & Legal, Administrative, Marketing, and Distribution.
- Assignment types: full-time, contract, temp-to-hire, part-time, and travel (with housing and logistics support for travelers).
- Every candidate is credentialed and compliance-checked before placement.
- Headquartered in Chicago, Illinois; places candidates in the Chicago metro and nationally.
